events.WAR_DECLARED: Official Declaration of War: {source} issued a formal declaration of war against {target}, ordering nationwide military mobilization.

events.VICTORY_ACHIEVED: Historic Decisive Victory: The empire of {source} achieved absolute hegemony over global politics and economy.
events.HUMAN_DEFEATED: Total Sovereignty Collapse: The realm of {source} lost all territorial holdings and governance structure.
events.COALITION_FORMED: Emergency Containment Coalition: The powers enacted a mutual defense containment accord, declaring total war on {source}.

events.NATION_COLLAPSED: Total State Dissolution: The realm of {source} was dissolved after losing all sovereign provinces.
events.NATION_BANKRUPTCY: National Bankruptcy Alert: Due to debt breaching 45% GDP, national treasury reserves of {source} were liquidated and infrastructure productivity penalized by 25%.
events.DIPLOMATIC_PROPOSAL_SENT: Diplomatic Proposal: {source} sent an official proposal ({proposal}) to {target}.

events.EMERGENCY_PROTECTORATE_CANCELLED: Protectorate Treaty Terminated: {source} terminated colonial protectorate ties with {target}.
